name: FAKE5
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A Take-5-style 5- or 10-voice poly: two oscillators with continuous shape, sub, noise, sync and linear FM 2>1, a driven 4-pole low-pass, two DADSR envelopes, two LFOs, sixteen mod slots on a display page, vintage, overdrive, voice spread, twelve effects and a plate reverb, arp and 64-step sequencer. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages.
